result.reason: The redline narrowly and effectively changes the Warranty Period to 90 days and removes the premature outside date, while preserving the existing correction, replacement, and refund framework. It therefore meets the fallback duration requirements and the preferred service-duration requirement, but it does not reach either complete position because it omits the professional-and-workmanlike and legal-compliance warranties, retains only qualified substantial conformance, and limits the malicious-code warranty to willfully introduced code of specified types.
